heading: About Jyotiba Instruments Enterprises
metaDescription: JIE provides industrial measuring instruments, calibration, sales and repair services, with reliable support for measurement needs.
intro: Jyotiba Instruments Enterprises is a trusted partner providing customers with industrial measuring instruments, plus calibration, sales and repair services, with a commitment to accurate results and reliable support for measurement needs.

In the company's own words, JIE is one of the best calibration service providers in Belgaum, Hubli, Dharwad, Pune and Ahmedabad, offering prompt and cost-saving calibration and certification across mechanical and pressure, thermal, electro-technical, civil and medical categories.

whatWeDo.title: What JIE does
whatWeDo.paragraph: The company works across industrial measuring instruments, gauges and test equipment; mechanical measuring instruments; bio-medical equipment; and civil equipment — taking on calibration, certification, sales, servicing, repairs, and the supply of instruments and spares.
activities: Calibration of a wide range of instruments and equipment
Supply of instruments and spare parts

audiences.title: Who we serve
audiences.paragraph: Industries, technical institutes, medical institutes, hospitals, government projects, and regulatory and audit requirements all appear among the segments JIE works with.

principles.title: Service approach
principles.paragraph: Price and scope are kept simple: calibration is restricted to the equipment necessary to meet product-liability and safety requirements and, where relevant, BIS and ISO standards. Certification is maintained and updated, traceable to National / International Standards.

items.title: Simple, cost-effective pricing
items.body: Service is priced to be simple and cost-effective, with calibration restricted to the equipment that genuinely needs certification.

items.title: Traceable certification
items.body: Certification is maintained and updated, traceable to National / International Standards, with documentation intended to satisfy regulatory and audit requirements.

items.title: Tool-error adjustment
items.body: Where tools or equipment are outside tolerance, repairs or adjustments are carried out wherever possible to bring them back within specified limits.

items.title: Minor repairs free of charge
items.body: Minor repair work is free of charge for clients. Major repair work is charged extra at actual.

processIntro: Four steps from receipt to return, with documentation intended for product-liability, regulatory and audit requirements.
placesNote: The business runs from a calibration lab in Belgaum and a branch office in Hubli, with offices also stated in Pune and Ahmedabad and customers served across Dharwad.
